The '''Crimson Prowler gear''' was a type of [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] clothing that was sold by [[6U-N5]] at the [[Republic outpost (Felucia)|Republic outpost]] on [[Felucia/Legends|Felucia]] for eighty [[Felucia Mission Token]]s.
